blocks.zh: 第三部分9–11節及第四部分：包裝標籤、實驗室管制、取樣與分析
blocks.en: Part III Sections 9–11 and Part IV: Packaging and Labeling, Laboratory Controls, Sampling and Analytical

blocks.zh: 📋 本節學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: 📋 Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握無菌產品包裝操作中的關鍵管制點（容器密封完整性、未貼標產品追蹤、溫控品）
blocks.en: Understand the critical control points in sterile product packaging operations (container closure integrity, tracking of unlabeled product, temperature-controlled products)

blocks.zh: 理解實驗室管制系統的六大核心：無菌測試、內毒素測試、環境監測、人員監測、消毒劑效力驗證、OOS 調查
blocks.en: Understand the six core elements of the laboratory control system: sterility testing, endotoxin testing, environmental monitoring, personnel monitoring, disinfectant efficacy validation, and OOS investigations

blocks.zh: 了解 OOS 無菌測試結果之重大性，以及 CGMP 對「無效化」條件的嚴格限制
blocks.en: Appreciate the significance of an OOS sterility test result and the strict limits CGMP places on the conditions for invalidation

blocks.zh: 記住取樣數量要求：無菌測試 48 單位、內毒素 20 單位的基準
blocks.en: Remember the sample quantity benchmarks: 48 units for sterility testing and 20 units for endotoxin

blocks.zh: 認識 FDA 分析實驗室的地區分配架構（NER/SER/CER/PAR/SWR 對應各 Lab）
blocks.en: Know how the FDA analytical laboratories are assigned by region (NER/SER/CER/PAR/SWR and the corresponding labs)

blocks.zh: III.9 Packaging & Labeling System ── 包裝與標籤系統
blocks.en: III.9 Packaging & Labeling System

blocks.zh: 🏭 包裝與標籤系統的查廠重點
blocks.en: 🏭 Inspection Focus for the Packaging and Labeling System

blocks.zh: 📦 包裝操作中的容器/密封完整性
blocks.en: 📦 Container/Closure Integrity During Packaging Operations

blocks.zh: 灌裝操作所建立的密封完整性（CCI）可能因後續包裝操作而受損，因此 FDA 查廠員必須評估：
blocks.en: The container closure integrity (CCI) established during filling can be compromised by subsequent packaging operations, so FDA investigators must evaluate:

blocks.zh: 包裝線的管制措施是否能保護已密封容器
blocks.en: Whether the controls on the packaging line protect the sealed containers

blocks.zh: 包裝過程中是否對密封容器進行過程中檢查（in-process check）
blocks.en: Whether in-process checks are performed on sealed containers during packaging

blocks.zh: 包裝線速度與壓力是否經過驗證
blocks.en: Whether packaging line speed and pressure have been validated

blocks.zh: 損壞容器是否在貼標前即被剔除
blocks.en: Whether damaged containers are rejected before labeling

blocks.zh: ⚠️ 未貼標產品的管制
blocks.en: ⚠️ Control of Unlabeled Product

blocks.zh: 標籤混淆（label mix-up）是 FDA 歷年來查察發現的常見問題之一。關鍵管制措施：
blocks.en: Label mix-up is one of the most common findings in FDA inspections over the years. Key controls:

blocks.zh: 分隔儲存：未貼標產品與其他產品須實體隔離
blocks.en: Segregated storage: unlabeled product must be physically separated from other products

blocks.zh: 標籤對帳：發出數量 = 使用量 + 銷毀量（差異須解釋）
blocks.en: Label reconciliation: quantity issued = quantity used + quantity destroyed (any discrepancy must be explained)

blocks.zh: 貼標後 100% 外觀確認：品項、規格、批號須正確
blocks.en: 100% visual verification after labeling: item, strength, and lot number must be correct

blocks.zh: 🌡️ 溫控產品的特殊要求
blocks.en: 🌡️ Special Requirements for Temperature-Controlled Products

blocks.zh: 冷藏（2–8°C）或冷凍無菌品在包裝作業期間同樣須維持溫控：
blocks.en: Refrigerated (2–8°C) or frozen sterile products must also remain temperature-controlled during packaging operations:

blocks.zh: 包裝區或包裝機台的溫度監測記錄
blocks.en: Temperature monitoring records for the packaging area or packaging equipment

blocks.zh: 各包裝步驟間產品是否返回適當儲存
blocks.en: Whether product is returned to appropriate storage between packaging steps

blocks.zh: 溫度偏差（temperature excursion）的累計評估報告
blocks.en: Cumulative assessment reports of temperature excursions

blocks.zh: 運輸容器的驗證（需涵蓋最極端氣候條件）
blocks.en: Validation of shipping containers (which must cover the most extreme climatic conditions)

blocks.zh: 💡 實務類比：包裝就像最後一關守門員
blocks.en: 💡 Practical Analogy: Packaging Is the Last Goalkeeper

blocks.zh: 無菌灌裝的密封就像「建構了保護罩」，而包裝操作若缺乏管制，等於把這個保護罩暴露在各種物理衝擊中。FDA 的邏輯是：驗證不只在灌裝，後續每一個可能影響 CCI 的操作步驟都需要受控。
blocks.en: The seal created in aseptic filling is like "building a protective shield," and packaging operations without adequate control expose that shield to all kinds of physical stress. FDA's logic is that validation does not stop at filling: every subsequent operation that could affect CCI needs to be controlled.

blocks.zh: III.10 Laboratory Control System ── 實驗室管制系統
blocks.en: III.10 Laboratory Control System

blocks.zh: 🔬 實驗室管制系統的查廠要點
blocks.en: 🔬 Key Inspection Points for the Laboratory Control System

blocks.zh: 🧫 無菌測試（USP <71>）關鍵要素
blocks.en: 🧫 Key Elements of Sterility Testing (USP <71>)

blocks.zh: 培養基促生長測試：每批培養基均需驗證，使用特定菌株（硫醇甘露酸鹽培養基用 Cl. sporogenes；TSB 用 C. albicans + A. brasiliensis）
blocks.en: Growth promotion testing of media: required for every media lot, using specified strains (Cl. sporogenes for fluid thioglycollate medium; C. albicans + A. brasiliensis for TSB)

blocks.zh: 方法適用性測試（bacteriostasis / fungistasis）：每一產品都需驗證產品不會抑制微生物生長
blocks.en: Method suitability testing (bacteriostasis / fungistasis): must be demonstrated for each product to show that the product does not inhibit microbial growth

blocks.zh: 孵育條件：30–35°C（FTM）+ 20–25°C（SCDM），各 14 天
blocks.en: Incubation conditions: 30–35°C (FTM) + 20–25°C (SCDM), 14 days each

blocks.zh: 環境要求：測試環境需達 ISO 5 (Class 100)；建議使用隔離艙（isolator）
blocks.en: Environmental requirements: the test environment must meet ISO 5 (Class 100); use of an isolator is recommended

blocks.zh: 🦠 內毒素測試（USP <85>）
blocks.en: 🦠 Endotoxin Testing (USP <85>)

blocks.zh: LAL 鱟試劑法（Limulus Amebocyte Lysate）為主要方法
blocks.en: LAL method (Limulus Amebocyte Lysate) is the primary method

blocks.zh: 干擾測試（I/E testing）：確認產品與 LAL 試劑相容
blocks.en: Inhibition/enhancement (I/E) testing: confirms that the product is compatible with the LAL reagent

blocks.zh: MVD 計算：最大有效稀釋倍數，需有文件化計算依據
blocks.en: MVD calculation: maximum valid dilution, which requires a documented basis for the calculation

blocks.zh: 限量：通常 0.5 EU/mL（鞘內注射）；5 EU/kg/hr（靜脈注射）
blocks.en: Limits: typically 0.5 EU/mL (intrathecal); 5 EU/kg/hr (intravenous)

blocks.zh: ⚠️ 環境監測（EM）程序的常見缺失
blocks.en: ⚠️ Common Deficiencies in Environmental Monitoring (EM) Programs

blocks.zh: 只監測白班：FDA 要求所有班次均需監測
blocks.en: Monitoring the day shift only: FDA expects monitoring on all shifts

blocks.zh: 未設定 Alert / Action Level：兩者均需依 ISO 等級分別定義
blocks.en: No Alert / Action Levels defined: both must be defined separately for each ISO classification

blocks.zh: 趨勢分析缺失：即使單次未超標，趨勢惡化也需調查
blocks.en: No trend analysis: even if no single result exceeds a limit, a worsening trend must be investigated

blocks.zh: 取樣點輪換不足：應涵蓋所有關鍵區域與支援區域
blocks.en: Insufficient rotation of sampling locations: sampling should cover all critical areas and support areas

blocks.zh: 📊 人員監測要求（Personnel Monitoring）
blocks.en: 📊 Personnel Monitoring Requirements

blocks.zh: 手套監測頻率：每次無菌作業結束時（daily 或更頻繁）
blocks.en: Glove monitoring frequency: at the end of each aseptic operation (daily or more frequently)

blocks.zh: 更衣監測頻率：定期（無菌區通常每月或更頻繁）
blocks.en: Gowning monitoring frequency: periodic (typically monthly or more frequent for aseptic areas)

blocks.zh: 限量：ISO Grade A 手套通常要求 0 CFU
blocks.en: Limits: 0 CFU is typically required for gloves in ISO Grade A

blocks.zh: 更衣資格確認：定期重新確認人員更衣技術
blocks.en: Gowning qualification: personnel gowning technique must be requalified periodically

blocks.zh: 🧴 消毒劑效力驗證要點
blocks.en: 🧴 Key Points for Disinfectant Efficacy Validation

blocks.zh: 多種消毒劑輪換：通常 2–3 種，防止抗藥性（包含一種殺芽孢劑 sporicide）
blocks.en: Rotation of multiple disinfectants: typically 2–3 agents to prevent resistance (including one sporicide)

blocks.zh: 材質試片測試：需使用廠房實際表面材料（不能只用 SS 片）
blocks.en: Surface coupon testing: must use the actual surface materials in the facility (not just stainless steel coupons)

blocks.zh: 環境分離菌株：挑戰菌須包含廠內分離的環境菌
blocks.en: Environmental isolates: challenge organisms must include environmental isolates recovered from the facility

blocks.zh: 接觸時間：必須與實際操作接觸時間一致
blocks.en: Contact time: must be consistent with the contact time used in actual operations

blocks.zh: 🔍 微生物鑑定程序
blocks.en: 🔍 Microbial Identification Procedures

blocks.zh: 關鍵區域（ISO 5 / Grade A）所有分離菌均需鑑定至菌種層級
blocks.en: All isolates from critical areas (ISO 5 / Grade A) must be identified to species level

blocks.zh: 必須鑑定的情形：陽性無菌測試、Media Fill 陽性、EM 超標（Alert/Action Level）
blocks.en: Identification is required for: positive sterility tests, positive media fills, and EM excursions (Alert/Action Level)

blocks.zh: 常用方法：MALDI-TOF 質譜儀、16S rRNA 定序
blocks.en: Commonly used methods: MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry and 16S rRNA sequencing

blocks.zh: 🚨 OOS 無菌測試結果：FDA 的嚴格立場
blocks.en: 🚨 OOS Sterility Test Results: FDA's Strict Position

blocks.zh: 初次陽性無菌測試結果是 CGMP 下的重大事件。FDA 的立場非常明確：
blocks.en: An initial positive sterility test result is a significant event under CGMP. FDA's position is very clear:

blocks.zh: 無效化（invalidation）只有在有清楚文件化的實驗室錯誤時才被接受
blocks.en: Invalidation is accepted only when there is clearly documented laboratory error

blocks.zh: 「有菌生長但找不到原因」= 不可無效化
blocks.en: "Growth observed but no cause found" = cannot be invalidated

blocks.zh: 有效的無效化理由：文件化的儀器故障、確認的程序偏差、記錄在案的操作員錯誤
blocks.en: Valid grounds for invalidation: documented equipment malfunction, confirmed procedural deviation, or recorded operator error

blocks.zh: 若調查指向產品或製程問題，必須全面調查，包含：製造記錄、EM 數據、人員監測、Media Fill 歷史、CCI 數據
blocks.en: If the investigation points to a product or process problem, a full investigation is required, including: manufacturing records, EM data, personnel monitoring, media fill history, and CCI data

blocks.zh: FDA 對頻繁無效化陽性無菌測試的廠商持高度懷疑態度。
blocks.en: FDA is highly skeptical of firms that frequently invalidate positive sterility tests.

blocks.zh: 💡 類比：實驗室是最後一道安全網
blocks.en: 💡 Analogy: The Laboratory Is the Last Safety Net

blocks.zh: 如果說無菌製程是「建造保險箱」，那實驗室就是「測試保險箱是否真的鎖好」。因此 FDA 要求：測試本身要可靠（培養基要能生長）、測試環境要無菌（ISO 5）、結果要被認真對待（不能輕易無效化）。
blocks.en: If the aseptic process is "building the safe," the laboratory is "testing whether the safe is really locked." This is why FDA requires that the test itself be reliable (media must support growth), that the test environment be sterile (ISO 5), and that results be taken seriously (they cannot be invalidated lightly).

blocks.zh: III.11 Sampling ── 取樣
blocks.en: III.11 Sampling

blocks.zh: 📋 取樣管理的查廠重點
blocks.en: 📋 Inspection Focus for Sampling Management

blocks.zh: 🧤 無菌取樣技術
blocks.en: 🧤 Aseptic Sampling Technique

blocks.zh: 查廠員取樣如果操作不當，可能造成「假陽性」結果，讓好產品被判定為不合格。因此 FDA 查廠員本身也需要遵循無菌技術：
blocks.en: If an investigator samples improperly, a "false positive" result may occur, causing a good product to be judged unacceptable. FDA investigators themselves must therefore follow aseptic technique:

blocks.zh: 使用滅菌的取樣器材
blocks.en: Use sterilized sampling equipment

blocks.zh: 溫控產品全程冷鏈維持
blocks.en: Maintain the cold chain throughout for temperature-controlled products

blocks.zh: 完整的 chain of custody 文件記錄
blocks.en: Keep complete chain of custody documentation

blocks.zh: 📁 文件樣品（Documentary Samples）
blocks.en: 📁 Documentary Samples

blocks.zh: 除了實體產品，FDA 查廠員還會帶走大量文件的認證複本：
blocks.en: In addition to physical product, FDA investigators will take away certified copies of many documents:

blocks.zh: 批次生產紀錄（certified copy）
blocks.en: Batch production records (certified copy)

blocks.zh: 實驗室測試紀錄
blocks.en: Laboratory test records

blocks.zh: 環境監測數據
blocks.en: Environmental monitoring data

blocks.zh: 偏差與調查報告
blocks.en: Deviation and investigation reports

blocks.zh: 驗證協議與報告
blocks.en: Validation protocols and reports

blocks.zh: 穩定性數據、SOP
blocks.en: Stability data and SOPs

blocks.zh: 這些文件構成 FDA 事後評估的重要依據。
blocks.en: These documents form an important basis for FDA's subsequent evaluation.

blocks.zh: 🗃️ 留樣（Retain Samples）要求
blocks.en: 🗃️ Retain Sample Requirements

blocks.zh: 依 21 CFR 211.170：
blocks.en: Per 21 CFR 211.170:

blocks.zh: 每批產品均需留樣
blocks.en: Retain samples are required for every lot of product

blocks.zh: 留樣條件需符合產品標示（如冷藏品須冷藏留樣）
blocks.en: Retention conditions must comply with the product labeling (e.g., refrigerated products must be retained under refrigeration)

blocks.zh: 處方藥留樣期限：有效期限後 1 年
blocks.en: Retention period for prescription drugs: 1 year after the expiration date

blocks.zh: Part IV: Analytical ── 分析（FDA 實驗室）
blocks.en: Part IV: Analytical (FDA Laboratories)

blocks.zh: 🧪 FDA 分析實驗室架構
blocks.en: 🧪 Structure of the FDA Analytical Laboratories

blocks.zh: 📋 三大核心 USP 分析法
blocks.en: 📋 Three Core USP Analytical Methods

blocks.zh: USP <71> 無菌測試：直接接種法或薄膜過濾法；30–35°C / 20–25°C 各 14 天
blocks.en: USP <71> Sterility Tests: direct inoculation or membrane filtration; 30–35°C / 20–25°C, 14 days each

blocks.zh: USP <85> 細菌內毒素測試：LAL 法（凝膠、濁度、顯色）；每次測試需含 Positive Product Control（PPC）
blocks.en: USP <85> Bacterial Endotoxins Test: LAL methods (gel-clot, turbidimetric, chromogenic); each test must include a Positive Product Control (PPC)

blocks.zh: USP <788> 注射劑微粒：光阻法（首選）；LVI（≥100 mL）和 SVI（<100 mL）限量不同
blocks.en: USP <788> Particulate Matter in Injections: light obscuration (preferred); limits differ for LVI (≥100 mL) and SVI (<100 mL)

blocks.zh: 💡 為什麼取 48 單位做無菌測試？
blocks.en: 💡 Why Take 48 Units for Sterility Testing?

blocks.zh: USP <71> 規定的最低測試數量通常是 10–20 單位（依批量大小）。FDA 要求 48 單位是因為：
blocks.en: The minimum number of units for testing under USP <71> is typically 10–20 (depending on batch size). FDA requires 48 units because:

blocks.zh: FDA 實驗室需要進行獨立測試
blocks.en: FDA laboratories need to perform independent testing

blocks.zh: 廠商也可以同時進行自己的測試（雙份確認）
blocks.en: The firm can also run its own testing at the same time (duplicate confirmation)

blocks.zh: 萬一需要複驗，有足夠的備份樣品
blocks.en: Enough backup samples are available if retesting is needed

blocks.zh: 這體現了 FDA 「但信任、要驗證」的原則：不依賴廠商的測試結果，而是獨立驗證。
blocks.en: This reflects FDA's principle of "trust, but verify": it does not rely on the firm's test results but verifies independently.

blocks.zh: 🗺️ FDA 地區實驗室分配
blocks.en: 🗺️ FDA Regional Laboratory Assignments

blocks.zh: 注意：中部區（CER）也送往 NRL，而非設立於中部的實驗室。
blocks.en: Note: the Central Region (CER) also sends samples to the NRL rather than to a laboratory located in the central region.

blocks.zh: 📌 本節重點總結 Section Summary
blocks.en: 📌 Section Summary

blocks.zh: 包裝系統：灌裝後的密封完整性（CCI）需延伸管控至整個包裝流程；未貼標產品需嚴格隔離與帳目對帳
blocks.en: Packaging system: container closure integrity (CCI) after filling must be controlled throughout the entire packaging process; unlabeled product requires strict segregation and reconciliation

blocks.zh: 無菌測試：培養基每批需促生長測試；每種產品需方法適用性測試；ISO 5 環境；初次陽性結果是重大事件
blocks.en: Sterility testing: growth promotion testing for each media lot; method suitability testing for each product; ISO 5 environment; an initial positive result is a significant event

blocks.zh: 內毒素測試：LAL 法（USP <85>）；需干擾確認（I/E）；每次含 PPC
blocks.en: Endotoxin testing: LAL method (USP <85>); inhibition/enhancement (I/E) confirmation required; PPC included in every test

blocks.zh: 環境監測：全班次監測；Alert/Action Level 分別定義；需趨勢分析；關鍵區域菌株需鑑定至菌種層級
blocks.en: Environmental monitoring: all shifts monitored; Alert/Action Levels defined separately; trend analysis required; isolates from critical areas identified to species level

blocks.zh: 人員監測：每次無菌作業後監測手套；Grade A = 0 CFU 標準；定期重新資格確認
blocks.en: Personnel monitoring: gloves monitored after each aseptic operation; Grade A = 0 CFU standard; periodic requalification

blocks.zh: 消毒劑驗證：多種輪換（含殺芽孢劑）；材質試片測試；需包含廠內環境菌株
blocks.en: Disinfectant validation: multiple agents in rotation (including a sporicide); surface coupon testing; in-house environmental isolates must be included

blocks.zh: OOS 無菌測試：只有清楚文件化的實驗室錯誤才可無效化；不能以「找不到原因」為由關閉
blocks.en: OOS sterility tests: invalidation only for clearly documented laboratory error; "no cause found" is not a basis for closing

blocks.zh: 取樣數量：無菌測試 48 單位；內毒素 20 單位
blocks.en: Sample quantities: 48 units for sterility testing; 20 units for endotoxin

blocks.zh: FDA 分析實驗室：NER/CER → NRL；SER → SRL；PAR → SAN-DO；SWR → DEN-DO
blocks.en: FDA analytical laboratories: NER/CER → NRL; SER → SRL; PAR → SAN-DO; SWR → DEN-DO

blocks.zh: 關鍵 USP 方法：USP <71>（無菌）、USP <85>（內毒素）、USP <788>（微粒）
blocks.en: Key USP methods: USP <71> (sterility), USP <85> (endotoxin), USP <788> (particulate matter)
